Setup Image Replication
========================

Configure automatic image replication between Harbor registries.

Step 1: Add Remote Registry
---------------------------

1. Go to Administration > Registries
2. Click "New Endpoint"
3. Fill in remote Harbor details

Step 2: Create Replication Rule
--------------------------------

1. Go to Administration > Replications
2. Click "New Replication Rule"
3. Configure source and destination

Step 3: Test Replication
------------------------

Trigger manual replication to test.

Step 4: Schedule Replication
----------------------------

Set up automatic replication schedule.
